items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Questions on Topics 299
items.html: What is the meaning of the fact that all the ascents of the worlds that were before the sin were clarified only through the MAN of Ima, and not through the MAN of the Nukva? 300) What is the meaning of the fact that the sin of the Tree of Knowledge is similar to the breaking of the vessels, in which emissions came out without a coupling? 301) Why in the breaking of the vessels were Panim and Achor broken, while in the sin of the Tree of Knowledge only the Achoraim alone? 302) Why did BYA fall below the Parsa, since the vessels of Panim were not damaged? 303) What is the meaning of “on the day that you eat of it you shall surely die”? 304) What is the meaning of the fact that all of Assiya is holiness, except that it is clothed in Klipot? 305) What are the inner and outer aspects of the worlds? 306) What are the three original aspects in BYA? 307) What are the two corrections that guard against another breaking of the vessels ever occurring? 308) What are the hundred Keterim that remained in Adam HaRishon after the sin? 309) Why is there in the Keterim that remained to Adam HaRishon only the illumination of the Malchuyot alone? 310) What are the three aspects that are discerned in the souls of Adam HaRishon after the sin? 311) Why does Beria receive from the second coupling of AVI, Yetzira from the face-to-face coupling of ZON, and Assiya from the back-to-back coupling of ZON? 312) Why in Beria is there Ona, in Yetzira Sh’er, Kesut, and in Assiya only Sh’er? 313) What are the remnants that remained from three within three in Assiya? 314) What is the meaning of the fact that in Beria it is HaVaYaH with the vowels of Elokim, and in Assiya it is Elohim Acherim? 315) What is the meaning of Elohim Acherim that cling between the joints? 316) What are the seven general aspects that must be discerned in BYA? 317) The five Partzufim of BYA, are they at an equal level, or is one lower than the other? 318) By what do BYA differ from Atzilut, and by what are they equal to one another? 319) What are the inner and outer aspects of the totality of BYA, the inner and outer aspects of the Sefirot, and the inner and outer aspects of the worlds? 320) Why are the Nefesh and Ruach of BYA of separation? 321) When did the Partzufim of Achor of AA, AVI, and ZA descend to BYA? 322) Why were the vessels of the ten Sefirot divided into outer and inner? 323) Why are the outer vessels purer than the inner ones? 324) Why is there Nefesh and Ruach of the inner and GAR of the outer? 325) Why are the angels the outer aspect of the worlds, and the souls of human beings the inner aspect? 326) Why is there not only one inner aspect in the two vessels, inner and outer? 327) What is the meaning of the fact that Keter is clothed in Hochma, and Hochma in Bina, and Bina shines in Beria? 328) Why does Beria receive only from Tevuna, and not from Ima? 329) What is the meaning of the fact that Tevuna spreads to ZON in the manner of inner light, and rests upon them in the secret of surrounding light? 330) Why is AA of Beria VAK without a head? 331) What is the meaning of the fact that a Risha in the thirteen Tikkunei Dikna could not emerge in Beria? 332) Why is Abba of Beria VAK without a head? 333) Why were the HAGAT of AA made into an uncovered Risha? 334) Why are only the NHY of AA clothed in AVI? 335) Why is Atik clothed in the HAGAT of AA in Beria? 336) How does YESHSUT clothe AVI, and ZON clothe YESHSUT, in the world of Beria? 337) Why is AA of Yetzira three within three? 338) Why is Abba of Yetzira three within three? 339) What is the upper aspect of the NHY of AA? 340) Why was the upper aspect of the NHY of AA made into an uncovered Risha in Yetzira? 341) What are the two lower ones of the NHY of AA? 342) Why were only the two lower ones of the NHY of AA clothed in AVI of Yetzira? 343) Why is AA of Assiya three within three? 344) Why is Abba of Assiya only a point? 345) Why do Ima and ZON have NHY in Assiya? 346) Why in all of BYA are the surrounding lights lacking for Ima, while ZA has one surrounding light and the Nukva two surrounding lights? 347) What is the meaning of the fact that the HAGAT of AA pass through a screen? 348) What is the meaning of the fact that the Malchut of Atzilut pierces and breaks the screen and descends to Beria? 349) What is the need for the point of Malchut to descend to Atik of Beria, since there is an Atik in Beria itself? 350) From where do there come Klipot as a garment of Atzilut? 351) What is the meaning of the fact that when YH ascend and join with VH, then all the Klipot are nullified? 352) Once he says that the Klipot are around every world, and another time that they are at the bottom of every world. 353) Why before the sin were the ZON of Klipot VAK and a point? 354) Why through the damage of the sin was AA concealed in AVI, and only AVI shine in Beria? 355) What is the meaning of the fact that AA was concealed and caused the Nukva of ZA to return to a point? 356) What is the meaning of the fact that since a further damage was added in AA and Abba in Beria, AVI were added to the Klipot? 357) What is the meaning of the fact that since the light of Ima also grew dark in Yetzira, AA was added there to the Klipot? 358) What is the meaning of the fact that since the light of ZA also grew dark in Assiya, Atik was added there to the Klipot? 359) Once, that in Beria AVI were added to the Klipot, in Yetzira AA, and in Assiya Atik. And another time, that in Beria only Ima was added to the Klipot, in Yetzira Abba, and in Assiya AA. 360) What is the matter of the ascents of the worlds of Klipot, which ascend equally with the BYA of holiness? 361) If the BYA of Klipot ascend and are included in one another equally with holiness, why do the Klipot remain in the fourteen Sefirot from the chest of Yetzira downward even on the day of Shabbat? 362) What is the difference between the surrounding lights of circles and straightness, and the garments and Heichalot, since both are surrounding lights of Haya and Yechida? (to the answer)
